bills.title: Telecommunications Legislation Amendment (Triple Zero Custodian and Emergency Calling Powers) Bill 2025

name: The majority voted against [amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2025-10-08.24.2) introduced by Lindsay MP [Melissa McIntosh](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/lindsay/melissa_mcintosh) (Liberal), which means they failed. Ms McIntosh [explained that](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2025-10-08.24.2): > *The first point in my amendment seeks to list our triple 0 network as critical infrastructure. This will ensure that the triple 0 service is enshrined as an infrastructure asset of national significance.* > > *The second point in my amendment will increase the current penalty framework for a contravention of the act from $10 million to $20 million.* ### Amendment text > *(1) Schedule 1, page 3 (before line 3), before the heading specifying Telecommunications (Consumer Protection and Service Standards) Act 1999, insert:* > >> *Security of Critical Infrastructure Act 2018* >> >> *1A Section 5 (after paragraph (a) of the definition of critical telecommunications asset)* >> >>> *Insert:* >>> >>> *(aa) a telecommunications network that is used to supply an emergency call service; or* > > *(2) Schedule 1, page 3 (before line 3), before the heading specifying Telecommunications (Consumer Protection and Service Standards) Act 1999, insert:* > >> *Telecommunications Act 1997* >> >> *1B After paragraph 570( 3)( ac)* >> >>> *Insert:* >>> >>> *(ad) in the case of a contravention of subsection 151D(1) or (2) of the Telecommunications (Consumer Protection and Service Standards) Act 1999$20 million for each contravention; or* > > *(3) Schedule 1, item 7, page 13 (after line 19), after section 151K, insert:* > >> *151KA Register of ECS outage events* >> >> *(1) The Custodian must establish and keep a register of ECS outage events.* >> >> *(2) The Custodian must include an ECS outage event in the register as soon as reasonably practicable after the Custodian reasonably believes that the ECS outage event has occurred, is occurring or wi
